sentences.text: Police Station Arthuna, District Banswara, Rajasthan.

----Respondents
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Shambhoo Singh Rathore
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mahipal Bishnoi, P.P.
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kuldeep Mathur
Order 18/05/2023

This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.57/2022 registered at Police Station Arthuna District Banswara for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366, 344, 376(2)(n),
376(3) IPC and Section 5(L)/6 POCSO Act.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that prosecutrix Mst. 'N' aged about 16 years old voluntarily eloped with present petitioner on his motorcycle who is aged about 20 years.

Drawing attention of the Court towards the statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., learned counsel (2 of 3) [CRLMB-706/2023] submitted that from the perusal of aforesaid statement, it is evident that the petitioner and prosecutrix travelled to Ahmedabad using public transportation.

Learned counsel submitted that they stayed in thickly populated areas and thus, the prosecutrix had ample opportunities of disclosing the fact of being abducted or sexually assaulted to co-passengers or neighbours/people living nearby to the place where they resided.

Learned counsel submitted that as a matter of fact, the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case on Deevan @ Bapuda vs State Of Rajasthan on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140375257/
1 the relationship between prosecutrix and petitioner turning strained.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Challan in the case has already been filed.
The petitioner is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application.

Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the bail application filed by the petitioner deserves to be accepted.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner - Deevan @ Bapuda S/o Late Shri Shankar arrested in connection with F.I.R.
No.57/2022 registered at Police Station Arthuna District Banswara shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every (3 of 3) [CRLMB-706/2023] date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 13-Ravi Kh/-
